hits.snippet: # Remepy Raises $36 Million to Advance Hybrid Drug Pipeline Remepy, a biotechnology company developing a new class of medicines that combine prescription drugs with personalized, AI-driven therapeutic applications, has raised $36 million in a Series A financing round to expand its Hybrid Drug platform and advance its lead Parkinson’s disease program. The financing was led by O.G. Venture Partners and M Ventures, the corporate strategic venture arm of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany. Existing and new investors participating in the round include NFX, Vine Ventures, Qumra Capital, TechAviv, 97212 Ventures, Fresh Fund, PsyMed Ventures, Tadmor Group, Key1 Capital, and IT-Farm Corp. The latest financing brings Remepy’s total capital raised to $62 million. Remepy said the proceeds will be used to accelerate pharmaceutical co-development partnerships, expand its Hybrid Drug pipeline and platform, and support global Phase III clinical development of Hybridopa, its lead investigational program for Parkinson’s disease.
